create_Human36mDataset: create a Human36mDataset instance from a serialized .npz file path with optional static joint removal
load_h36m_skeleton: load the Human36mDataset skeleton definition with 32 joints and left/right joint mappings
configure_h36m_cameras: configure Human36mDataset with intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters for all subjects
remove_h36m_joints: remove static joints from the Human36mDataset skeleton reducing 32 joints to 17
check_semi_supervised: check if Human36mDataset supports semi-supervised learning via supports_semi_supervised method
